 North Texas vs. FAU prediction, odds, time: Week 9 college football Thursday picks from proven model
 SportsLine's model revealed its best bets for Thursday's American Conference matchup of the North Texas Mean Green vs. FAU Owls
 By
 Ross Kelly 
 Oct 29, 2026
 at
 5:30 pm ET 
 •
 2 min read
 Imagn Images 
 A pair of 5-2 teams in the American Conference will square off on Thursday's college football schedule as the FAU Owls visit the North Texas Mean Green. Florida Atlantic is 2-1 in conference play, while North Texas has won all three of its American contests. The Mean Green are coming off a 10-point win over Navy on Saturday, marking its fourth straight triumph.  Kickoff is set for 7:30 p.m. ET from DATCU Stadium in Denton, Texas. The Mean Green are 14-point favorites in the latest FAU vs. North Texas odds, while the over/under for total points is 77.5, one of the highest totals in a game this year.  Top FAU vs. North Texas predictions
 After simulating North Texas vs. FAU 10,000 times, SportsLine model is going Under 77.5 points at  betting apps .  While both teams have heavily leaned over this season, this is a massive total points line. It's 13.5 points higher than any other Week 9 FBS game, as well as 13.5 points higher than any prior game this season involving FAU or North Texas. None of these teams' recent matchups in Texas have even approached 76.5 as their last four have averaged 60.3 points.
 Despite both teams being known more for their prolific offenses than their stout defenses, both squads rank among the top four in passing defense in the American. They aren't as successful in stopping the run, and the ground game eats up the clock. The model projects the teams to combine for nearly 300 rushing yards, which prevents them from coming close to the over/under. The model forecasts 58 combined points as the Under hits in 86% of simulations.  See the model's FAU vs. UNT spread and money-line picks at SportsLine .
